definition: A small container with handles used to carry items while shopping.

exact_brief_revision.before: Use a three-quarter view of a compact rigid store basket with raised carrying handles and a few recognizable groceries below the rim. Keep the handheld basket distinct from a wheeled shopping cart. Exclude wheels, fabric sides, a lid, and groceries that obscure the handle or opening. Use the inspected original Mini Market shopping-basket mesh without geometry or material changes.

findings: The original mesh is a rigid green basket with a raised light-colored handle, an open top and no wheels, fabric sides or lid.
The chosen rear three-quarter view shades the broad handle face, preserving contrast against the actual light card surface without changing materials.
At minimum Match and Memory sizes, the handle and open basket remain visible in both unmatched and matched states.
The adjacent accepted cart has a taller body, a rear push handle and visible wheels; the basket has an arching carrying handle and no wheels. The comparison does not depend solely on color.
limitations: The source is stylized and has no independent human scale cue.
The eight-card comparison is an agent visual inspection, not a participant recognition test.
Native candidate textures were assigned directly to actual WordCard controls for isolated artwork QA; this does not establish production delivery.
